response.likely_cause: Severe degradation in image sharpness and overall image quality at the clinic, likely due to hardware or capture technique issues.
evidence: Drift score of 0.96 observed over 50 scans in week 9.
Mean sharpness decreased from 0.000399 in training to 1.21e-05 in flagged scans, a relative change of -0.97.
Mean image quality dropped from 0.5 in training to 0.208, a relative change of -0.584.
Mean brightness dropped from 0.373 in training to 0.313, a relative change of -0.161.
Evidence strength is moderate to strong: while sample size is small at 50 scans, the drop in sharpness and quality is extreme and corroborated by visual inspection of blurry, dark scans.
recommended_checks: Inspect and clean the camera lens for smudges, dust, or fingerprints.
Verify flash brightness settings and auto-focus functionality on the camera.
Retrain operators at clinic US-WEAR-01 on proper image acquisition and patient positioning.
